title:
Broadway Frank
2 miles from Broadway
description:
Step into the spotlight of Nashville's Rhythm with our Frank Sinatra-inspired getaway!
Imagine crooning "My Way" from our private rooftop patio under a full awning, gazing at the Breathtaking Nashville skyline that lights up the night. Sink into the luxurious beds after a day exploring Broadway's Honky Tonks, just minutes away. Fully renovated, Sinatra-era chic kitchen, perfect for crafting your own cocktails. This isn't just a Stay-it's your ticket to an Unforgettable Nashville Adventure!

The space
Townhome
3rd Floor - Private Rooftop with Nashville Skyline view, Retracting Awning,  Outdoor Furniture with FirePit, Great Spot for Guests Entertainment.
Full Equipped Kitchen, Living Area with PullOut Sofa, Half Bath
Snack and Beverages are available for guests

2nd Floor - Master Bedroom with King size bed, Full Bath, 2 sink vanity
 Bedroom with Queen size bed, Powder Room with sliding door into Full Bath with Tub
Full size washer and dryer located on this floor as well

1st Floor - Bedroom with Queen size bed, Full Bathroom
Garage that will hold one vehicle, keyless entry located on Front Door

Blow Up Queen Mattress 

Please Note, any stains on bedding or furniture will have to pay an extra fee for clean or replacement

Other Notes
  For Groups Larger..........
Please reach out for potential accommodations. We have another space located a street away that can hold 12 guests, so we can accommodate 22 guests Total!

Guest access
Entire home and private patios to enjoy the view of the Nashville skyline.
